sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩看著一個怪物玩具或怪物裝扮，怪物外表有一點嚇人但表情和動作很好笑，例如做出笨拙滑稽的姿勢。女孩一開始有點驚訝，接著笑出來。怪物不能太恐怖，不能有血、尖銳攻擊或驚悚感。

It is mildly startling in silhouette but ridiculous and nonthreatening. Girl has raised surprised eyebrows and a clearly amused open smile with one hand covering her giggle, not crying. Make both mild scariness and funny pose legible. No human monster identity or violent threat.
